div.head: V Atr 22.1
div.ab: ⁊ gearwige eac to huslgange oft ⁊ gelome gehwa hine sylfne,
⁊ gearwige eac to huslgange oft ⁊ gelome gehwa hine sylfne,
⁊ gearwige eac to huselgange oft ⁊ gelome gehwa hine silfne.
And gearwige eac to huslgange oft and gelome gehwa hine sylfne.
And everyone shall also prepare himself frequently and often for receiving the sacrament.
And everyone is also to prepare themselves often and frequently to receive the sacrament.
And everyone is to prepare himself often and frequently for going to communion;
Und jeder bereite sich auch oft und häufig zum Abendmahl
And let everyone also prepare himself often and frequently to go to communion,
